name: Hyoscine butylbromide
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Relaxes GI and genitourinary smooth muscle, does not cross the blood–brain barrier

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Hyoscine butylbromide, oral, 20 mg 8 hourly as required.
Hyoscine butylbromide, SC/IM, 20 mg. · Increase dose to effect to maximum of 120 mg.

dosing.h: Acute Pain due to Gastrointestinal Colic

items.t: Hyoscine butylbromide, oral, 10 mg 6 hourly for a maximum of 3 days.
Hyoscine butylbromide, oral, IM or IV: · 1 month to 4 years: 300–500 mcg/kg 6–8 hourly. Maximum: 5000 mcg/dose (5 mg/dose).
Hyoscine butylbromide, SC/IV: · 1 month to 4 years: 300–500 mcg/kg (maximum: 5 mg/dose) 6– 8 hourly.

cautions.t: IV use can cause tachycardia and hypotension – caution in cardiac disease

adverse_effects.t: Dry mouth, tachycardia, blurred vision, urinary retention
